BackupHealth.description: Backup age as health reports it.

state.description:
`ok`, `stale` (older than the threshold), `missing` (none taken yet)
or `unreadable` (the status file cannot be read).

BackupManifest.description: One completed backup, as its manifest records it.

file.description: File name inside the backup directory.

tool.description:
The tool that took a recorded database-native backup. Absent on
backups this module takes, so their manifests are unchanged.

BindPreview.description: What binding a bundle would do, without writing anything.

already_bound.description: True when the environment already has this bundle bound (a replay).

carries_revocations.description: True when the bundle carries a key revocation list to install.

scan.description: The import scanner's outcome, when one is configured.

sha256_fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 of the certificate's DER, as `openssl x509 -fingerprint
-sha256` prints it: uppercase hex pairs joined by colons (#809).

ChangeEvent.description: One durable change. `cursor` is the opaque resume token (monotonic sequence).

ChangeEventKind.description: Closed set of change-event kinds advertised on the HTTP contract.

ChangeEventPage.description: Bounded page of change events plus the cursor to resume from.

ChannelListEntry.description: Identifying fields, current head, and active hold for one channel.

ClockHealth.description: The last clock reading, as health reports it.

skew_ms.description: Time-source time minus local time, from the last successful reading.

state.description:
`ok`, `warn`, `refuse`, or `unknown` (no successful reading yet, or the
last measurement failed).

CollectedApproval.description: One collected, still-detached envelope for a plan.

CompatibilityEvidence2.description:
Observations describe the candidate's constituents and installed dependencies.
The environment owner supplies this evidence; it grants no execution authority.

CompatibilityReport.description: Public reports contain requirement identifiers, never observed facts or payloads.

missing.description: Referenced content this host holds no bytes for, as `<release> <digest>`.

oci_store_bytes.description: Bytes under the OCI store; absent when no store is configured.

weight_cache_bytes.description: Bytes under the weight cache; absent when no cache is configured.

stored.description:
Whether this host holds a file named for this digest: a layer under
any registry path of the OCI store, a weight in the cache. Files are
found by name and not re-hashed here; import, apply and fetch verify
the bytes. An environment still pulls a layer through its own mirror
path. Absent when the store that would hold it is not configured.

CredentialRunway.description:
A certificate that lapses before an environment's next maintenance window
opens, so a plan waiting for that window would fail at apply time (#778).
Advisory: it never blocks the plan or changes its steps.

credential.description: The certificate's purpose, with its subject when readable.

DeliveryHold.description: Durable evidence that delivery is paused for a scope.

DeliveryHoldView.description: Active hold plus set/clear/retry history for one scope.

DrillEvidence.description: Evidence that one backup restored into a scratch store and opened.

EffectiveApprovalPolicy.description:
Operator-facing policy: automatic signer key ids, human rules, and TTL.
Never includes seed bytes or file contents.

EnvironmentConfigChange.description:
One configuration change. The variant decides the route: its resource
path and whether it is a `PUT` or a `DELETE`.

operational.description: Operational events the endpoint also receives (#724).

oneOf.description: Clears one URL, or every webhook when `url` is absent.
`path` names a policy file on the server host. Never key material.

EnvironmentConstraint.description: One environment constraint, as set by `tenkaictl env constraints set`.

name.description: Product for version constraints; fact key for `require_fact`.

EnvironmentInspectReport.description: Detailed inspect report for one environment (no credentials).

delivery_hold.description: Present while delivery is paused for this environment.

execution_note.description: Execution ownership note: Tenkai never prints runtime bearer tokens.

latest_plan.description: Most recent plan for this environment by `created_at`, if any.

maintenance.description:
Maintenance windows and their eligibility at inspect time. Absent for
projections that do not read Tenkai-owned environment configuration.

module_activations.description: Accepted workshop-module activation receipts for this environment.

observed_runtime_digest.description: Observed runtime digest used for workshop-module compatibility admission.

observed_type_digest.description: Observed type digest used for workshop-module compatibility admission.

preview.description: Present only for preview environments bound to a branch pin.

retirement.description: Present after this environment has been retired from operational use.

terminal_outcomes.description:
Bounded terminal-outcome identities and outbox delivery state. Event
payloads and retry errors are intentionally excluded.

EnvironmentLeaseInspect.description: Operator-facing lease/fence summary. Never includes credentials.

held.description: Whether an active apply/execution lease is held.

owner.description: Lease owner identity (controller id), never a bearer token.

EnvironmentListEntry.description: Summary row for fleet listing (no credentials).

delivery_held.description: The environment or one of its subscribed channels is held.

EnvironmentMaintenanceInspect.description:
Read-only view of the environment's own maintenance schedule, evaluated
with the same rules as apply admission. Product maintenance windows
(`tenkaictl product maintenance`) are not included and may further
restrict when a plan touching that product can apply.

detail.description: When `invalid`: why the configuration cannot be evaluated.

eligibility.description:
`unrestricted` (no environment windows), `open`, `closed`, or
`invalid`. Invalid configuration blocks apply until it is corrected.

next_opens_at_ms.description: When `closed`: next opening of any window, in Unix milliseconds.

open_until_ms.description: When `open`: end of the current window, in Unix milliseconds.

next_opens_at_ms.description:
Next start of this window strictly after inspect time, in Unix
milliseconds; absent when the window cannot be evaluated.

start.description: Local wall-clock start in HH:MM form.

weekdays.description: ISO weekday numbers: Monday is 1 and Sunday is 7.

approval.description: Whether the latest plan was approved by policy or still needs a human.

digest.description:
`sha256:` digest of the versioned executable-plan encoding, the value
the plan route returns and approvals bind to. Absent for projections
without an executable plan, such as development fixtures.

status_detail.description: Bounded operator-facing lifecycle detail; never contains executable payloads.

steps.description: Ordered, bounded summaries of executable steps.

steps_truncated.description: True when `step_count` exceeds the number of returned summaries.

EnvironmentRetirement.description: Durable evidence explaining why an environment is no longer operational.

delivery_hold.description: Present while the subscribed channel is held.

ExportEntry.description: An export with its events, oldest first.

file_name.description: The name the download carries, as the CLI would name the file.

ExportEvent.description: Who created or downloaded an export, when, and why.

oneOf.description: Hub-wide: the next signed `tenkai.audit-export.v1` of this host's chain.

reason.description: Why the export is made; recorded with the creator.

FleetEnvironmentRow.description: One environment's row in a fleet posture table (no credentials).

latest_plan_state.description:
Latest plan state when a plan exists. Fleet status leaves this empty;
`inspect_environment` is the source for plan detail.

products_behind.description: Subscribed products with a deployment that is not the channel head.

products_current.description: Subscribed products whose deployed version matches channel head.

products_missing.description: Subscribed products with no deployed version.

unhealthy.description: True when any subscription has health `unknown` or a non-empty error.

server_version.description:
The server's own version, which runners and consoles compare
against (#761).

HoldAuditEvent.description: One immutable set, clear, or retry transition.

preview.description: What the bind does (or did); present once the bundle verified.

refusal.description: The exact refusal, for example a missing layer digest or an expired interval.

bundle.description: File name inside the staging directory.

upgrade.description: The isolated upgrade the bundle binds to.

oneOf.description: A dry run that would succeed.

installed_at.description:
When the installed file was last written, Unix milliseconds: an
install or bundle import replaces it, and the process applies it at
start (#811).

issued_at.description: When the authority signed the list, Unix milliseconds (#811).

ManagementLifecycleResult.description: Versioned result shared by catalog lifecycle routes.

MigrationListEntry.description: Identifying fields and current state for one stored package migration.

ModelEvaluationEvidence.description: Chisei → Tenkai evaluation result for the same identity.

ModelReleaseIdentity.description: Shared model identity for both evidence directions.

ObservedInitJob.description: Last completed one-shot init job for a Docker topology.

ObservedModelRuntime.description: Observed model_runtime identity and accelerator fit facts.

ObservedRuntimeComponent.description: Observed state of one deployed product on an environment.

ObservedRuntimeUnit.description: One running or declared Docker unit.

OidcClientDiscovery.description:
Unauthenticated `GET /v1/auth/oidc` body: what a browser needs to start
Authorization Code + PKCE. Public values only.

OperationalEvent.description:
Operational events of [`crate::operational_events`] (#724). They live in
their own endpoint field, `operational`, so a version that does not know
them ignores the field and keeps the endpoint's apply subscriptions.

oneOf.description:
A certificate the host serves or trusts entered a warning, critical
or expired status (#775).

PageQuery.description: Query parameters for cursor-paged catalog lists.

PlanApprovalView.description: Whether a plan was approved by policy or still needs a human, and why.

PlanApprovalsView.description: Collected versus missing approvals for one plan and purpose.

PlanRunway.description:
A plan waiting to apply and the first certificate that would lapse
before it can (#811).

blocked_by.description:
The first TLS certificate to lapse at or before that window. Absent
when none does. Signers are not checked: trust roots record no
signer validity.

window_opens_at_ms.description:
When the plan can next apply: the environment's next maintenance
window, Unix milliseconds. Absent when it may apply now.

QuorumPurpose.description:
Purpose a quorum rule applies to. Derived from the plan and apply flags;
the v1 envelope purpose stays `execute_plan`.

QuorumRule.description: N distinct human signers from named groups for one purpose.

exclude_requester.description: When true, the apply requester's principal cannot count toward N.

ReleaseListEntry.description: Identifying fields and current digest/version for one published release.

RunnerAuth.description:
How a runner authenticates (#809), from what the server issued it, not
from what a request presented.

oneOf.description: A static token, or an enrolled credential never issued a certificate.

RuntimeEnrollmentIssued.description: A new enrollment. `token` is shown only here.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the token may be redeemed; default 15 minutes, at most 24 hours.

RuntimeRevokeRequest.description: Why a runner is revoked; recorded and shown on inspect.

RuntimeRunner.description:
One runner of the registry: an enrolled credential, or a static token
configured on the server. Never carries a secret.

auth.description: Always sent; optional so a newer client still reads an older server.

id.description: `sha256:` digest of the credential or token; what revoke takes.

instances.description: Instances that presented this runner's credential, most recent first.

state.description:
`active`, `revoked`, or `static` for a configured token, which only
server configuration changes.

RuntimeRunnerInstance.description:
What one instance of a runner last did. Activity is recorded at most
every 30 seconds per kind, so times can trail by that much.

holds_lease.description: Holds an unexpired runtime plan lease now.

skew.description:
The instance's version against this server: `current`, `behind`
(one minor release, supported), `unsupported` or `ahead` (#761).

ScanEvidence.description: What the scanner said about one import.

stdout_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the scanner's standard output and standard error, so the
full report can be matched to the scanner's own logs.

summary.description:
The first line of output (standard output, else standard error), at
most 200 bytes.

backup.description:
Backup age when backups are configured. `stale` or `missing` degrades
health without failing readiness: the server can still do its work.

clock.description:
Clock skew against the configured time source. `refuse` blocks
approvals, applies and runtime lease claims; readiness stays up.

contracts.description: API contract ids this server serves, for client compatibility checks.

trust.description:
The worst status of the host's certificates (#676), when any are
configured. It never fails readiness; `GET /v1/trust` has details.

SignerValidity.description: Whether a trust root's format records when each signer is valid.

oneOf.description: Trust-root format v1 has no `not_before` or `not_after` per signer.

error.description: Why the file could not be read, when it could not.

signer_validity.description:
Trust-root files carry no signer validity period, so a signer is
trusted until removed or revoked (#811).

source.description:
`file`: read from disk per request, as release, bundle-import and
revocation-authority verifiers read it per use. `loaded`: what a
verifier loaded at start (package-migration approvals), which adopts
a changed file only after a restart (#811).

StagedBundle.description: One archive in the staging directory.

chunked.description: True when a `<stem>.chunks/` store sits beside the archive.

environment.description: Present when the file parses as a bundle; signatures are not checked here.

unreadable.description: Why the file is not a readable bundle.

delivery_hold.description: Present while the subscribed channel is held.

TerminalOutcomeProjection.description:
Bounded, authenticated read projection of one Tenkai-owned terminal
outcome and its optional-provider delivery state. The projection contains
identities and digests only; the original event payload and retry error are
never returned to an operator or integration client.

runtime_client_cert_required.description:
Runtime routes refuse a connection without a verified client
certificate, enrollment and renewal aside (#809).

status.description: The worst certificate status; `ok` when nothing is about to lapse.

TrustSource.description:
Whether an entry shows material the server loaded and uses, or a file as
it is on disk now, which a client that read it at startup adopts only
once restarted.

revoked.description: Revoked by the key revocations this process enforces.

WebhookDelivery.description: One webhook delivery as `GET .../webhooks/deliveries` reports it.

last_error.description: The last failure, as the worker recorded it.

WebhookEvent.description: Stable apply-lifecycle events a webhook endpoint may subscribe to.

description: Routes, required delivery capability, and request/response schemas. Non-2xx responses carry `error`.
title: Tenkai HTTP API
